title: Building Wiz: the fastest-growing startup in history | Raaz Herzberg (CMO and VP Product Strategy)
summary: Raaz Herzberg is the chief marketing officer and VP of product strategy at Wiz. Wiz hit $100 million ARR within 18 months (the fastest growth in startup history) and, five years in, is generating over $500 million ARR. It also serves over 45% of the Fortune 100. Raaz was one of the first five employees at Wiz, joining as the first product manager, and helped the team pivot to what may be the most intense PMF in history. Before Wiz, Raaz led security products at Microsoft, including Azure Sentinel. In our conversation, we discuss: • How Wiz pivoted from their initial idea and found deep product-market fit • What Raaz learned about listening to customers • Why she moved from product to marketing, despite no prior experience • How she thinks differently as a marketer with a product background • Lessons learned from scaling a hypergrowth startup like Wiz • Much more — Brought to you by: • WorkOS
